lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs2K4Ti4I12 (reduced formula CsKTiI3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ti centers in octahedral environments coordinated by six I atoms, while K and Cs each have 12 I neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements; the I centers have two geometric neighbors, one K and one Ti. Polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies Ti–Ti octahedral corner sharing, and K–Ti polyhedra exhibit both corner and face sharing, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
